name: novatech-ecommerce
description: Plateforme e-commerce fullstack (React + Node.js + MongoDB + Stripe) — Projet d'examen : boutique de produits informatiques

scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
